description: Architected and deployed a scalable Document Intelligence pipeline automating data extraction from invoices, resumes, and visiting cards, reducing manual data-entry effort by ~70%. Built an end-to-end OCR + LLM inference pipeline converting unstructured files into validated Pydantic JSON schemas, eliminating manual post-processing. Designed and shipped a RESTful FastAPI service on a fully local, open-source stack (FastAPI, PaddleOCR, local Ollama LLMs) to ensure complete data-residency compliance and zero API fees.

Conducted exploratory data analysis (EDA) on student performance datasets using Python to surface academic risk trends, reducing score variance by 20%. Quantified the impacts of key sociological performance drivers by building segmented statistical comparisons, translating findings into actionable academic recommendations.
